name: blueprint-panel
title: Blueprint Panel
description: Hairline panel with registration marks outside the corners, a mono header with an index and meta slot, and a footer. A calm frame for anything that should read as a drawing sheet.

props.description: The frame. A section that extends every section prop.

props.name: tone
props.description: default and clay sit on the card surface, inset sits on a recessed muted surface. clay tints the corner marks.

props.name: markers
props.description: Draws registration marks outside the four corners.
A 40 px mono header row with a bottom hairline.

props.name: index
props.description: Muted index before the title, for example 02 or SH-01.

props.name: meta
props.description: Right aligned muted content such as a revision.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Heading element used for the title.
Padded body that grows to fill the panel. Extends every div prop.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged with the base padding, so p-0 or a grid layout can replace it.
Mono footer row with a top hairline. Extends every footer prop.

examples.title: Spec sheet
examples.description: Header with index and revision, a definition list and a footer.

accessibility: Renders a section. Give it aria-label or aria-labelledby when the header title should name it.
The header title is a real heading and headingLevel keeps the document outline correct.
Registration marks are aria-hidden and ignore pointer events.
Header and footer text use foreground and muted foreground tokens, which stay above 4.5:1 on the card surface.
